elements.name: Show Home navigation beside the recent document list

steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
Part23.opd from the disposable package is open with Sketch1 being edited
a part document is active in the MCAD Software
the part has an active sketch editing environment
the user chooses Home from the View ribbon Switch menu
the Home workspace displays Open and New actions in a left navigation rail
a Recent area appears to the right of the rail
the Recent area offers list view, grid view, search and filter controls
the part document remains available as an open tab
